info.description:
The course consists of 6 Units focusing on different genres related to nutrition, psychology, travel, technology, education and economy. 

In each unit, students will learn structure of each type of essay such as description, narration, comparison-contrast, opinion, cause-effect, along with the application of grammar topics and vocabulary appropriate for each category and subject.

- Each unit includes 5 parts namely Stimulating Ideas, Brainstorming and Outlining, Developing ideas, Editing your writing, and Review.

clos.loDetails: Understand the structure of an academic paragraph, how to construct a coherent and concise paragraph, the relationship between paragraphs and short essays, the structure of an essay; understand and distinguish the common genres of essay such as descriptive, narrative, comparison and contrast, opinion, and cause-effect essays.
Apply the knowledge learned to write proficiently academic paragraphs and/or essays of various genres; apply knowledge and skills in English writing in their lives and future profession
Self-assess his/ her own writing products and those of others; develop self-study skills to equip oneself with linguistics, vocabulary, and essay writing skills
Understand the importance of writing skills in English linguistics; be diligent and passionate in writing in English; be confident in the knowledge and skills gained through this course
